name: Mechanism Atlas H3 Step 1 bibliography
exact_hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 undergoes increased aggregation in the endo-lysosome compared with APOE3.

studies.author: Kaji 2024
studies.system: recombinant purified ApoE and mouse amyloid pathology; some human AD autopsies
studies.specificity_limit: Purified isoform aggregation contrast not a living human endolysosomal observation; ApoE-Halo 5xFAD mouse study not human APOE3/4 comparison

studies.author: Rawat 2019
studies.system: mouse primary astrocytes, mouse hippocampus, human CSF and cell-free assay
studies.specificity_limit: Insoluble fraction ≠ proven fibril in healthy human brain-cell endosome

studies.author: Hatters 2006
studies.system: cell-free purified ApoE and neuron-like cultures
studies.specificity_limit: No endolysosomal localization in intact human brain cells

studies.author: Fote 2022
studies.system: HEK293 stably expressing ApoE3 or ApoE4, other engineered cells
studies.specificity_limit: Accumulation and flux changes do not prove isoform-specific ApoE fibrillar aggregation

studies.author: Konings 2023
studies.system: N2a neuroblastoma uptake and APP/PS1 primary mouse neuron conditioned media
studies.specificity_limit: Uptake, puncta, APP βCTF/Aβ antibody overlap not APOE aggregate proof

studies.author: Xia et al. 2024 Nature Communications
studies.systems: cell-free Aβ/apoE co-aggregation; human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells and human iNPC-derived astrocytes exposed to preformed non-lipidated apoE-Aβ co-aggregates
studies.caveat: No endogenous intralysosomal ApoE4 aggregation is measured. Source row 3 mislabels lipidated-condition isoforms (two ApoE3 and no ApoE4); no lipidated E3-vs-E4 pairwise numeric result was used. Three biological replicates are not independent human parental donors. Report author p/n only when exact source supports.

methodology: Primary published panel-specific evidence extraction; explicit N/A for missing p/n; Class5 when complete H3 compartment+human+aggregation chain not measured
strongest_gap: No paper here simultaneously demonstrates de-novo APOE4-vs-APOE3 endolysosomal aggregation in non-aged non-Alzheimer human isogenic brain cells.
